scope.excluded_topic_rule: Concept and reference topics remain required supporting content, but they are not represented as independently executed user actions.
scope.execution_method: Committed browser smoke for representative product paths plus deterministic per-topic DITA/source/test simulation for every included task and troubleshooting topic.

normalization.rule: Each workflow_reviews entry expands to one protocol review item for every topic_id in topic_ids.

field_resolution.recovery_path: documentation/src/dita/en/user/{topic_id}.dita /task/taskbody/postreq plus workflow.recovery_path and the topic related-links section

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can retain profile context while changing locale or theme and while moving between editor tabs.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against the shared page header and editor-route state.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and simulated against locale, theme, and route-state controls.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; locale/theme changes do not mutate profile data or lose the active surface.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can create or import a profile, choose its schema and starting configuration, save it, and reopen the intended editor.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against the Library, import boundary, schema catalog, presets, and CIS layers.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and simulated against current Library and Guided controls.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; a saved profile has a stable ID, revision, schema channel, and editor entry points.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can traverse all six Guided Editor steps, configure supported control families, review changes, save, and export.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against a deterministic Release/ESR profile fixture.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against the six-step Guided runtime mapping.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; saved and exported state matches the selected schema-supported guided controls.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can preserve context across editors, validate and save canonical profile state, and export Firefox policies.json.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against a saved deterministic profile.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against save, validation, mode-link, and export handlers.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; saved state has the expected revision and export returns the canonical Firefox document.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can distinguish Review, Configured, and Catalog modes and narrow settings by query, category, source, and state.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against the deterministic corporate CIS profile.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against the current All Settings modes, filters, counts, and bounded lists.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; the visible inventory and count match the selected mode and filters without mutating the profile.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can inspect one setting, edit or reset it, add a known managed preference, validate, and save.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against schema-backed setting and preference fixtures.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against the single detail panel and value adapters.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; the canonical profile contains the intentional validated value or no longer contains the reset value.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can inspect advanced/raw settings, preserve source attribution, follow a deep link, and record a CIS manual-review decision.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against imported, raw, manual, baseline, and CIS source-state fixtures.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against source badges, deep-link state, and review dispositions.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; the user can explain origin, support state, and the safe next action for the setting.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can inspect, edit, format, validate, and save the Firefox JSON boundary document without losing canonical profile state.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against valid, malformed, and schema-invalid JSON fixtures.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against the Monaco-backed JSON surface and validation pipeline.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; valid JSON saves to the profile while malformed or invalid JSON remains blocked with visible feedback.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can find and identify profiles, refresh and sort the Library, duplicate profiles, and safely manage archive/restore/delete lifecycle actions.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against active and archived deterministic profile rows.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against Library filters, row identity, confirmations, and status updates.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; each action changes only the intended row and exposes the resulting lifecycle state.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can open Compare, independently select two saved profiles, and interpret policy/preference equal, changed, and missing rows.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against two saved profiles with deterministic differences.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against independent selectors and the two-column comparison table.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; the user can identify which saved profile requires follow-up without Compare mutating either profile.

workflow_reviews.task_or_claim: Users can stop unsafe work, preserve visible context, recover from common validation/state/connection failures, and avoid internal data edits.
workflow_reviews.prerequisites: Resolved from each topic prereq and checked against deterministic conflict, malformed input, missing-row, and failed-action states.
workflow_reviews.exact_steps: Resolved from each topic step/cmd sequence and checked against current error/status/confirmation behavior.
workflow_reviews.expected_result: Resolved from each topic result; the workflow either resumes safely or stops with enough visible evidence for maintainer diagnosis.
recovery_path: Each topic is itself the terminal User Guide recovery path; persistent infrastructure failures hand off to Administrator troubleshooting.

browser_smoke.command_scope: Eight selected browser_ui nodes from tests/test_ui_browser_tabs.py covering locale/routes, import, Guided disclosure, Library lifecycle, All Settings, JSON, Compare, and Library edit/clone.
browser_smoke.environment: Repository Chromium/Selenium harness with isolated test application and database state.

api_and_source_simulation.command_scope: Four selected tests from tests/test_ui_smoke_profile_workflow.py covering Guided save/export, visual-to-JSON saves, stale revision conflict, and save-as-copy recovery.
api_and_source_simulation.environment: Isolated FastAPI test client plus maintained frontend-source assertions.

per_topic_contract.verified_boundary: All 72 action/recovery topics, six-locale prereq/step/result structure, taxonomy ownership, protocol fields, evidence paths, and recovery boundaries.

summary.result: Every User Guide task and troubleshooting topic resolves to explicit prerequisites, ordered commands, an observable result, a recovery path, drift sources, focused verification, and successful browser or deterministic simulation evidence.

unverified_boundaries: This review proves BPM UI and documentation behavior; it does not claim that an exported policy has been activated in a live Firefox deployment.
Native operating-system file picker and download-manager presentation is browser/OS-owned; BPM import/export request and response behavior is verified.
Human deployment policy choices remain administrator decisions; the review proves the documented controls and observable BPM results.
